title: Admin Utility Mosaic and Runbook Incubator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an "incubator" experience and backend primitives that let SREs and support engineers prototype, validate, and publish small admin utilities as first-class runbook tasks. The goal is a safe sandboxed surface for composing parameterized steps, validating inputs, and emitting standardized telemetry before promoting to the global runbook library.
background: Operators today maintain a mix of ad-hoc scripts, documented runbooks, and hand-cranked tooling. This causes duplication, brittle manual steps during incidents, and a slow feedback loop when iterating on remediation logic. The incubator reduces blast-radius by providing dry-run/simulation, RBAC gating, typed inputs, and automatic rollback templates.
proposal: Ship a lightweight incubation flow: 1) a template authoring UI (mosaic composer) for chaining micro-utilities; 2) a runtime shim that executes steps in sandboxed namespaces with configurable side-effect policies; 3) a validation pipeline that runs synthetic dry-runs and collects telemetry; 4) one-click promote to runbooks-as-tasks in the operator catalog with versioning and audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create an incubator utility from a template and define typed inputs (string, enum, secret-ref, duration)
Every utility supports dry-run mode that executes simulated side-effects (no infra changes) and returns structured results
RBAC enforcement: only groups with 'incubator.author' can publish; 'incubator.reviewer' can approve for promote
Telemetry emitted for start/finish/error/side-effect attempts with schema ops.incubator.v1
One-click promote produces a versioned runbook task with rollback metadata and audit log entry
E2E test demonstrates safe failure handling for a step that intentionally times out and triggers automatic cleanup
work_items: API: incubator templates CRUD + promotion endpoint
Runtime: sandbox adapter for NO_OP dry-run and REAL execution path toggle
UI: mosaic composer canvas, parameter panel, preview dry-run result pane
CLI: adminctl incubator preview + promote commands

Telemetry: define ops.incubator.v1 and wire into observability pipeline
Testing: unit, integration, and synthetic dry-run harnesses
Docs: quickstart + troubleshooting guide in Confluence and sample templates

decisions: Use JSON-schema for parameter typing instead of building a bespoke DSL
Dry-run will be implemented via a 'simulator' adapter that returns deterministic, recorded responses to avoid flakiness
Promotion will create an immutable runbook artifact stored in the runbook registry (git-backed) to allow easy rollbacks
Sandbox runtime will restrict network egress unless explicitly permitted by reviewers
tradeoffs: JSON-schema reduces expressiveness for some advanced conditional inputs but accelerates adoption and validation tooling
Using git-backed registry adds operational overhead for merges but gives clear provenance compared to a DB-only approach
Simulator approach requires maintaining realistic canned responses which can drift from real infra behavior over time
risks: Accidental promotion of unsafe utilities without adequate review could cause customer impact
Simulator fidelity mismatch could hide failures until after promotion
Overly permissive RBAC defaults could expose critical controls to non-privileged users
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable incubator for SRE beta group with dry-run only. Collect telemetry and failure modes over 2 weeks. Phase 2: gated promote with mandatory reviewer signoff. Phase 3: open to broader support teams and add CLI ergonomics. Full GA tied to console-2025.10 release and security review signoff.
